_source: Figma 'BW - DLS' (L1BiCOIR0Qir8wNEiMi8EI), reference frame 8146:28777 'Comment/Typing'. Adopted 2026-09-04 as the canonical design system; values read from the file's variables and styles.

colors.accent-blue: #3582FF (the one chromatic colour: selection, current step, focus)

layout.principle: floating panels over a full-bleed canvas; the canvas is the page, chrome floats with 12–16px inset
layout.top-toolbar: centred pill, surface-01, radius 12, toolbar shadow; segmented control inside
layout.right-inspector: 240–320px, surface-01, radius 16, popover shadow; opens only on selection
layout.bottom-bar: centred, surface-01, radius 20, prompt-input shadow; presenter controls only
layout.segmented-control: track surface-03 radius 10 padding 2; active segment surface-01 radius 8 + button shadow
layout.icon-button: 36×36 (44 hit area), radius 8, stroke-01, glyph 16px stroke 1.5
layout.list-row: 40px, radius 8, icon 28×28 in a surface-03 square, label body-large; active row surface-03

canvas.screenshot-capture: 1440x900 base, grown to content (cap 2200x10000), JPEG q65

node.title: heading 500 text-primary
node.titles: real h1 / dialog heading / active tab from the running app

_rules: Minimal chrome: one line of text per control at most; no explanatory sentences in the UI, kbd chips instead.
One chromatic accent (blue) for state; red only for broken/missing; everything else greyscale.
Confidence by line weight and dash, never by hue.
